🎥🚀: Futurama

Philip J. Fry’s ordinary life changes forever when a strange accident sends him 1,000 years into the future. In a world filled with advanced technology, alien species, and robotic companions, Fry begins a new chapter working for Planet Express alongside Leela, Bender, and the rest of the crew.

As they travel through space delivering packages, the team faces bizarre planets, futuristic problems, and unexpected dangers that challenge their friendships and beliefs. Futurama combines clever comedy, imaginative science fiction, and heartfelt stories that explore what it means to be human in an ever-changing universe.

Travel to the future with the latest season of Futurama streaming August 3 on Hulu and Disney+!
